# HaikuPorts packages the x86_64 app builds compile against (staged into the
# x86_64 SDK's DEPS by the haikuports recipe; their runtime dependencies are
# resolved automatically). arm64 has no HaikuPorts desktop repository: the same
# libraries are built from the airos-works forks there (deps/recipes/).
curl_devel
sqlite_devel
taglib2_devel
libpcre2_devel
scintilla_devel
lexilla_devel
openssl3_devel
ffmpeg6_devel
lzo_devel
lz4_devel
# curl with HTTP/3 (deps/recipes/curl.sh) builds against what HaikuPorts' curl links
nghttp2_devel
libpsl_devel
libssh2_devel
